## 4. Field status, timestamps and leakage check

| field | used by | status | timestamp | leakage check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| transactions: ISIN, type, timestamp (history) | LLM prompt + LambdaMART features | observed (reconstructed rows flagged) | 2021-03-19 … 2021-07-16 | OK: all < t (True) |
| transactions: totalValue, units, channel (history) | optional | observed / derived (value = units × price) | same as row | OK if from rows < t |
| customer: customerType | both | observed | 2021-03-19 | OK: snapshot ≤ t |
| customer: riskLevel | both | observed | 2021-03-19 | OK; 'predicted' flag kept, prediction date unknown |
| customer: investmentCapacity | both | observed | 2021-03-19 | same |
| customer: lastQuestionnaireDate | not used | observed / placeholder 2000-01-01 | 2022-02-16 | use only if ≤ t (here ≤ t) |
| asset: name, category, subCategory, sector, industry, market | both (text for LLM, categorical for LambdaMART) | observed static; ∅ = missing | asset_information.timestamp ≤ 2022-10-31 | low risk: static metadata |
| popularity of candidate (buyers in 6 m before t) | both | derived from rows < t | < t | OK |
| ItemKNN score / rank | LambdaMART feature, LLM sees order only if we choose | derived from rows < t | < t | OK |
| close prices ≤ t | optional | observed | ≤ t | OK only up to t |
| candidate eligibility (priced over whole test window) | protocol filter, identical for all methods | derived | uses prices up to 2022-11-29 | future info → must NOT be a feature |
| limit_prices.profitability | never | derived over 2018–2022 | whole period | LEAKAGE → excluded |
| test-window transactions | label only | observed | 2022-05-31 … | never an input |
